source_logic.public_basis: Open-source Liquidity Sweep Follow-Through Guard reconstruction
source_logic.reference_level: highest high / lowest low of previous 20 completed bars, excluding current bar
source_logic.sweep_depth: current bar must pierce reference by at least 0.10 previous-bar ATR20
source_logic.reclaim: sweep bar must close back inside the frozen reference
source_logic.rejection_wick: rejection-side wick >= 35% of sweep-bar full range
source_logic.dual_sweep_resolution: if one bar qualifies both sides, closing direction selects the episode
source_logic.episode_ownership: only one sweep episode active at a time
source_logic.follow_through: the next two completed closes must remain on the reclaimed side
source_logic.extension: second follow-through close must be at least 0.30 frozen ATR from sweep close in reversal direction
source_logic.path_efficiency: abs directional progress from sweep close to second follow-through close / cumulative absolute close-to-close path across the two follow-through bars >= 0.45
source_logic.entry: first executable P75 tick at/after second follow-through bar right edge

selection_rule: advance only preregistered profiles that pass supply/economic gates; rank strong survivors by direct net then official wins then trade count; no retuning
